tolkien.rebase.confirmMsg:
"{branch}" is rebased over the latest main from GitHub to keep working in parallel.

• If there's a conflict it ABORTS and your branch stays EXACTLY as it is (nothing is lost).
• After the rebase, the PR will need a force-push when you re-send it.

tolkien.updateAction.confirmMsg:
The latest from GitHub is pulled (stash → pull → stash pop).
Your local changes stay safe if something fails.
tolkien.updateAction.conflictMsg: There was a conflict reapplying your changes: they stayed in the stash (git stash list).
tolkien.refreshData.confirmMsg:
Leaves your LOCAL DB as a CLEAN, current snapshot of Zoho:

1) WIPES the operational tables (employees, clients, billing, invoices, PTO, teams…).
2) Reimports from scratch (clients → employees → links).

⚠️ ALL local edits to that data are lost (that's the point: no merge, no conflicts). Login and config are preserved. Doesn't touch prod or your code.

tolkien.refreshData.netError: Couldn't update the data (network or server error).
